---
title: Low Credit Vendors
description: List of vendors with zero or low credit balance, sorted lowest first, to follow up on credit top-ups.
---

## Overview

**Sidebar:** Vendors → Money → **Low Credit** (`/finance/low-credit-vendors`)

Shows vendors whose credit balance is at or below a chosen threshold, sorted lowest first. Vendors with too few credits cannot unlock new orders, so use this list to prompt top-ups before they go idle.

## What the screen shows

### Summary cards

| Card | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Zero Credits** | Vendors with 0 credits. |
| **Low Credits (1–50)** | Vendors with 1–50 credits. |
| **Total Listed** | Vendors in the current list (for the selected threshold). |

### Table columns

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| # | Rank (lowest balance first). |
| Vendor | Vendor name. |
| Phone | Contact number. |
| Shop | Shop name. |
| City | Vendor city. |
| Status | Vendor account status (e.g. live). |
| Credits | Current credit balance. |
| Level | Severity badge, e.g. **Critical** for the very lowest balances, **Low** for others. |

## Filters & search

- **Search** — name, phone or shop (press Enter).
- **Threshold** — Credits ≤ 10, 25, 50 (default), 100, 200, 500 or 1000.
- **Refresh** (top right) reloads the list.

<Callout kind="tip">
Vendors top up from the vendor app; their purchases appear on **Credits & Payments**. The **Vendor Report** also shows a short "Low Credit Vendors" card with a link to this screen.
</Callout>
